note: City of Shell Lake campground on the lake's west shore, a walk from downtown, beside the public swim beach and boat launch. Sites 1-12 sit on open lawn at the water; 7, 8, 11 and 12 are rented by the season. Water at the sites and restrooms may be shut off in cold weather. --Claude
summary: Booking site, 2026 policy PDF (2027 rates), map and all 46 per-site pages read: 2027 $40 (39-47, water+30A) / $50 (13-37, full hookups) / $65 (lakefront 1-12) + $10 reservation fee; 11-month window, same-day OK, 21-night limit per site; 46 sites (stored 47), 12 pull-throughs; 10 sites seasonal. Lakefront kept (sites 1-12 on open grass at the shore; 8 of them sold nightly).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakefront kept. The booking site types sites 1-12 'Water Front Site: Yes' (map: the 'LAKEFRONT' row between the loop road and Shell Lake). Esri imagery at 45.7414,-91.9230 (hw 200 m) shows that row's campers on open mown grass ~10-25 m from the shore, no road or tree band between. Of the twelve, 1-6, 9 and 10 are sold by the night ($65 in 2027); 7, 8, 11 and 12 are seasonal ('*This is a seasonal site that will only be available to reserve during the current year*').
FEES: stored $25-35 + $8 reservation fee (Washburn County's own park rates) -> $40-65 for 2027 + $10 reservation fee. Local, so no price gate; note the lakefront rate is $65.
SEASONAL SHARE: 10 of 46 sites are seasonal (7, 8, 11, 12, 20-24, 34); 36 sold by the night - not a long-stay park.
SITES: stored 47 (from the page's '47 sites') -> 46 bookable; site 38 is the camp manager's/office. Pads 30-55 ft; all fit a 23-ft rig.

HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 (derived from note prose '30/50-amp') has no source: the map gives '30 AMP Elec. & Water Only' for 39-47 and the per-site pages say only 'Electricity: Yes'. Left alone; the reviewer may clear it.
SEASON: no opening/closing dates published (the booking calendar shows April-October 2027 days open); left unset.
PIN: 45.7414,-91.9230 is inside the loop at the campground's centre; no move.

PHONE: 715-468-7846 kept (campground office, in season); the map gives (715) 468-7679 off season. WEBSITES: keep the booking page; http://www.shelllake.org/where-to-stay/ is the city's lodging list (it answers and points to the booking site) - keep or drop at the reviewer's choice.
